quote: I’ve heared so many bad things about this game before starting. It’s amazing. New combat style is something I hope future pokemon games keep, it makes pokemon battles fun. author: Loky9
quote: Something that started super fun and looking breathetaking, ended up a big disapointment. This game loses all the fun once you start thinking about not missing any gems, vaccuming everything, thinking if u missed something and then once u log back into game, everything u vaccumed is back into it’s original place. I had huge hopes for this games, but all those hiddes places, some places where you just don’t understand what to do, hard boss fights etc… ruined the experience completely. Not returning to this game ever.
